title_candidates: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate makes voice translation feel closer
summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, a near-real-time speech translation model for more than 70 languages across AI Studio, Translate, and Google Meet preview paths.

primary_source.title: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate is here
primary_source.author: Google DeepMind
key_facts: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate supports near-real-time speech-to-speech translation.
Google says it automatically detects more than 70 languages.
The model is rolling out through Google AI Studio, Google Translate, and Google Meet private preview paths.

prerequisites: Access to Google Translate or Google AI Studio
A short non-sensitive phrase to test

steps.instruction: Translate a short phrase and check both meaning and tone before using live translation in important settings.

risk_flags: Availability varies by product surface and account.
